description: Registration System (Task 13): replace the stub registration POST with atomic slot reservation using Prisma FOR UPDATE, add GET for admin, create PATCH approve/reject/request_correction endpoint, wire RegistrationForm.tsx to handle all error cases, and build the admin ParticipantsTable + participants page. Depends on FEAT-001 (state machine is available for import).
steps: Replace apps/web/src/app/api/servers/[guildId]/tournaments/[tournamentId]/registrations/route.ts with the full POST + GET implementation. POST: (1) Require Supabase auth via createClient() — return 401 if no user. (2) Look up dbUser via prisma.user.findFirst({ where: { discordId: user.user_metadata?.provider_id ?? user.id } }). (3) Parse body with RegistrationSubmitSchema from @esports/shared-types (discriminated union on format field) — return 422 on failure. (4) Find or create Team: prisma.team.findFirst({ where: { guildId, captainId: dbUser.id } }) or create with teamName from body. (5) Check duplicate: prisma.registration.findFirst({ where: { tournamentId, teamId: team.id } }) — return 409 { error: 'already_registered' }. (6) Inside prisma.$transaction: execute raw SELECT FOR UPDATE on the tournament row to prevent race: prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT id, team_capacity, accepted_count, auto_approve, waitlist_enabled, status FROM tournaments WHERE id = ${tournamentId} AND guild_id = ${guildId} FOR UPDATE`. Re-read the locked row values. If status !== 'REGISTRATION_OPEN' return 409 { error: 'not_open' }. If acceptedCount < teamCapacity: create Registration with status = autoApprove ? 'APPROVED' : 'PENDING', slotNumber = autoApprove ? acceptedCount + 1 : null. If autoApprove, increment acceptedCount: prisma.tournament.update({ where: { id: tournamentId }, data: { acceptedCount: { increment: 1 } } }). Create RegistrationMember rows from body player list. Create OutboxEvent { type: autoApprove ? 'REGISTRATION_AUTO_APPROVED' : 'REGISTRATION_SUBMITTED', guildId, payloadJson: { tournamentId, registrationId, teamId } }. If acceptedCount >= teamCapacity and waitlistEnabled: create Registration status='WAITLISTED', create OutboxEvent { type: 'REGISTRATION_WAITLISTED' }. If full and !waitlistEnabled: return 409 { error: 'slots_full' }. Return 201 { registration: { id, status, slotNumber } }. GET (wrapped in withPermission(TOURNAMENT_MANAGER)): query prisma.registration.findMany scoped { tournamentId, guildId }, accept optional ?status query param, return { registrations } including team.name, team.tag, _count.members, slotNumber, createdAt, approvedAt fields. Never returns PENDING registrations to non-admin routes.

Create apps/web/src/app/api/servers/[guildId]/registrations/[registrationId]/route.ts. Export PATCH = withPermission(AppRole.TOURNAMENT_MANAGER, async (req, { guildId, userId, params }) => { ... }). Extract registrationId from params['registrationId']. Body schema: z.object({ action: z.enum(['approve', 'reject', 'request_correction']), reason: z.string().max(500).optional() }). Fetch registration: prisma.registration.findFirst({ where: { id: registrationId, guildId }, include: { tournament: { select: { teamCapacity: true, acceptedCount: true } } } }) — return 404 if not found. For 'approve': inside prisma.$transaction: run SELECT FOR UPDATE on tournament row, check acceptedCount < teamCapacity else 409 { error: 'slots_full' }, compute slotNumber = acceptedCount + 1, prisma.registration.update({ where: { id: registrationId }, data: { status: 'APPROVED', slotNumber, approvedBy: userId, approvedAt: new Date() } }), prisma.tournament.update({ where: { id: tournamentId }, data: { acceptedCount: { increment: 1 } } }), create AuditLog { guildId, actorId: userId, action: 'REGISTRATION_APPROVED', targetType: 'Registration', targetId: registrationId, reason }, create OutboxEvent { type: 'REGISTRATION_APPROVED', guildId, payloadJson: { registrationId, teamId } }. For 'reject': prisma.registration.update({ status: 'REJECTED', rejectedBy: userId, rejectedAt: new Date(), rejectionReason: reason }), create AuditLog { action: 'REGISTRATION_REJECTED' }, create OutboxEvent { type: 'REGISTRATION_REJECTED' }. For 'request_correction': prisma.registration.update({ status: 'PENDING' }), create AuditLog { action: 'REGISTRATION_CORRECTION_REQUESTED' }. Return 200 { registration: updated }.

Update apps/web/src/components/tournament/RegistrationForm.tsx. Extend the handleSubmit function to interpret the API response body and status. Cases to handle: HTTP 201 with body.registration.status === 'WAITLISTED' → show a 'Added to waitlist' success variant (yellow/amber, not green). HTTP 201 with status 'APPROVED' or 'PENDING' → show existing green success card. HTTP 409 body.error === 'already_registered' → setServerError('Your team is already registered.'). HTTP 409 body.error === 'not_open' → setServerError('Registration is not open.'). HTTP 409 body.error === 'slots_full' → setServerError('Tournament is full and no waitlist is available.'). HTTP 422 body.details → map field-level errors and set them under the form using setError from react-hook-form (pass them to the sub-forms). Network error → keep existing 'Network error. Please check your connection.' message. Add an optional setSuccess state enum ('approved' | 'pending' | 'waitlisted') to show different messages.

Create apps/web/src/components/admin/ParticipantsTable.tsx. 'use client' component. Props interface: { guildId: string; tournamentId: string; initialData: RegistrationRow[] } where RegistrationRow = { id, status, teamName, teamTag, memberCount, slotNumber, createdAt, approvedAt, rejectionReason }. Render Radix Tabs with four tabs: Pending / Approved / Waitlisted / Rejected. Each tab shows a filtered table using @tanstack/react-table (same pattern as TournamentAdminTable.tsx). Columns: team name (with tag), member count, registration date, slot number (Approved tab), actions (Approve/Reject/Request Correction buttons). Action buttons call fetch(PATCH /api/servers/${guildId}/registrations/${id}) with { action, reason }. Show a sonner toast (import { toast } from 'sonner') on success and on error. Re-fetch the list on success by calling the registration list API and updating local state.

Create apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/admin/tournaments/[tournamentId]/participants/page.tsx. Server component. Pattern: import createClient, resolveUserRole, prisma. Auth check + redirect if no user. Resolve role — redirect if < TOURNAMENT_MANAGER. Fetch prisma.registration.findMany({ where: { tournamentId: params.tournamentId, guildId: params.guildId }, include: { team: { select: { name: true, tag: true } }, _count: { select: { members: true } } }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } }). Serialize to plain objects (convert Date fields to ISO strings). Render <ParticipantsTable guildId={...} tournamentId={...} initialData={serialized} />.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm --filter web type-check exits with code 0
POST /api/servers/[guildId]/tournaments/[tournamentId]/registrations returns 409 when tournament is not REGISTRATION_OPEN
POST returns 201 with status WAITLISTED when slots are full and waitlistEnabled is true
RegistrationForm shows waitlist success message for WAITLISTED response
findings: Registration POST route is at apps/web/src/app/api/servers/[guildId]/tournaments/[tournamentId]/registrations/route.ts — uses prisma.$queryRaw SELECT FOR UPDATE inside $transaction for atomic slot reservation. acceptedCount incremented in same tx when autoApprove=true. GET is admin-only (TOURNAMENT_MANAGER) via withPermission. PATCH approve/reject/request_correction route is at apps/web/src/app/api/servers/[guildId]/registrations/[registrationId]/route.ts — approve also uses SELECT FOR UPDATE + acceptedCount increment inside tx, writes AuditLog + OutboxEvent for all three actions. RegistrationForm.tsx now handles 201 WAITLISTED (amber/Clock icon), APPROVED (green), PENDING (green), and 409 error codes (already_registered, not_open, slots_full) with distinct messages. ParticipantsTable.tsx at apps/web/src/components/admin/ParticipantsTable.tsx renders Radix Tabs (Pending/Approved/Waitlisted/Rejected), @tanstack/react-table, inline action buttons, reason modal for reject/request_correction, sonner toasts, and re-fetches after each action. Participants admin page at apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/admin/tournaments/[tournamentId]/participants/page.tsx. RegistrationStatus enum imported from @esports/database for type-safe status filtering. pnpm --filter web type-check exits 0. Commit: 6b5f216.
